keyEvents.text: Goal! Saudi Arabia 0, Uzbekistan 1. Sherzod Esanov (Uzbekistan) right footed shot from outside the box to the high centre of the goal.

Abdulelah Al Amri (Saudi Arabia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Saudi Arabia 1, Uzbekistan 2. Sherzod Esanov (Uzbekistan) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal following a set piece situation.
